intl.title: Elmhurst - Admission for first-year international students (deadlines, English proficiency, scholarships)

intlhome.title: Elmhurst - International student admission requirements (overview, merit scholarships)

apply.title: Elmhurst - Apply (no application fee; Common App accepted)

test_policy.notes: Test-optional: applicants do not need to submit SAT or ACT scores to be considered; the international page lists SAT/ACT only as English-proficiency alternatives. Admission looks at grade trends from freshman through junior year and course rigor; at the Admission Review Board's discretion an applicant may be asked for an interview, essay or teacher evaluation form. No minimum GPA is published.

requirements.notes: No application fee. International first-year file: application, secondary transcript for all years (certified English translation if needed), IB/AP/CLEP scores if any, proof of English proficiency, then Declaration of Finances and Affidavit of Support (collected Mar. 1-Jun. 1 for fall). Fall I-20s are sent from June 1. Some majors require an audition or portfolio.

deadlines.label: International first-year application window closes (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Page says apply between September 1 and May 1, or until all spaces are filled, with no priority date. No year is printed; taken as the fall 2027 cycle (opens Sep 1, 2026). Spring entry: Aug 1 to Nov 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived for citizens who attended high school in listed English-speaking countries (e.g. Canada's English-speaking provinces, Australia, Ireland, UK, Jamaica); also for two semesters of U.S. college English (B or better), an American international school with passing English grades, an English-language IB program, South Korean CSAT English 1, or (I)GCSE English First Language C/4 / A-level English C. SAT EBRW 520 or ACT English and Reading 22 also satisfy the requirement. No conditional admission or ESL pathway is mentioned on the page.

english.notes: For tests taken after January 21, 2026; the page prints 4 without naming the 1-6 scale.
PTE Academic and Express; the page labels this 2027 and beyond.
B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency.

aid.notes: International first-year awards need no separate application and are based on the admission application: International Chairman's Award up to $20,000 and International Discovery Award $1,000-$5,000 (academic merit), plus international student tuition grants (amounts not listed). The overview page says merit awards can be worth up to $20,000 per year. International students are not eligible for federal aid.

cost.notes: Full-time undergraduate tuition $45,258 (2026-27), student fee $300 per term, room $7,454 plus 17-meal board $5,716.30; first-year students also pay a $275 matriculation fee. The cost-of-attendance page lists different room ($8,150) and food ($7,880) estimates, so budgets can differ from billed charges.

sat.note: Elmhurst's admissions pages give no SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: Elmhurst's admissions pages give no ACT code; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: The international page gives no ETS code; select Elmhurst University in the ETS list.
